user.title: Disk Usage Explorer
user.description: Choose the folders the card is allowed to scan.

data_description.allowed_roots: One absolute path per line, as seen by Home Assistant (for example /media). Only these folders and their subfolders can be scanned.

error.invalid_roots: Enter one or more existing absolute folders.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Disk Usage Explorer is already configured.

scan.name: Scan a folder
scan.description: Index a folder in read-only mode. Nothing is modified or deleted.

path.name: Path
path.description: Absolute folder path inside one of the allowed folders.

cancel.name: Cancel scan
cancel.description: Stop the running scan. Partial results are discarded.

browse.name: Browse scan results
browse.description: Return the contents of a folder from the latest completed scan.

path.name: Relative path
path.description: Folder path relative to the scanned folder. Leave empty for the scanned folder itself.

suggest_directories.name: Suggest folders
suggest_directories.description: Return existing subfolders matching a typed path, inside the allowed folders.

path.name: Partial path
path.description: Absolute path or the beginning of one.

not_configured.message: Add the Disk Usage Explorer integration before using this action.

path_not_absolute.message: The path must be absolute, for example /media/movies.

not_in_results.message: The folder {path} is not part of the latest scan.
